pencil_lead_today.label: ESTIMATE
pencil_lead_today.notes: 0.5 mm HB lead, 20 mm immersed, 5 ohm bare -> 0.5 ohm plated: Cu film 0 -> ~0.39 um, 0.33 C full range. 100 levels (read noise and morphology), plating efficiency ~0.9-0.95 vs stripping ~1 (asym 0.1), nucleation/stripping nonuniformity (gamma 0.3), write noise half a step, hand-made spread 20 %. Drift: Cu corrodes in aerated acid sulphate; central guess the full range is lost in ~10 h (tau 3.6e4 s); a 31-slot pulse train of ~10 ms slots is 0.3 s per sample, so tau = 3.6e4 / (0.3 x 128) = 940 batches.
pencil_lead_today.source: this lane's estimate (PLAN.md section 'pencil lead built today'); to be replaced by the bench

widrow1960_claimed.label: CLAIM+ESTIMATE
widrow1960_claimed.notes: n_states 1000 = the low end of 'thousands' (claimed, never measured in a modern sense). asym, gamma, c2c, d2d, ref_err are ESTIMATES (no 1960s figure survives in readable form). Drift: the ideal 'stays put indefinitely' is taken as claimed (tau = inf); the pessimistic twin below has drift.
widrow1960_claimed.source: Widrow, Pierce and Angell 1961 (TR 1552-2/1851-1), quoted in Wikipedia 'Memistor': 'thousands of possible analog storage levels', '100 ohms to 1 ohm', 'about 10 seconds with several milliamperes'; Widrow 1960 TR 1553-2 via Mouttet arXiv:1012.5124: near-linear conductance vs plating charge, brighteners to eliminate hysteresis

widrow1960_pessimistic.source: Gaines 1967: 'electro-chemical stores ... are unreliable or require sophisticated external circuitry'
